messages:
marta: Heads-up — planning a fast-path canary that touches API -> runtime -> console -> router. Target quiet window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC.

marta: Plan (short):
1) deploy runtime v2.3.1 canary at 5% (only a couple of shards)
2) route 5% via router shim (no header-swap)
3) console UI flag off by default, small telemetry only

marta: Staging note: we saw a ~+40ms p95 bump when kernel switch + small batch enabled. We'll enable hedging and KV-prefix cache for the canary to reduce noise.

marta: Need: pinwalks for kernel/quantize + router shim variant and a quick rollback owner. Anyone needs more time or objects? cc @deploybot

deploybot: Scheduled canary window created: 1738459991. Canary job queued: service=runtime pct=5 duration=15m monitor=latency,error_rate. Use `deploybot canary --service runtime --pct 5 --duration 15m --monitor latency,error_rate` to inspect.

kevin: runtime: ok to proceed but request pin: kernel-quantize -> v1.14 (we saw regressions on v1.15 in long sequences). Please pin to v1.14 for the 5% canary only. Also I'll be primary rollback owner.

liya: router: we cannot do header-swap on shard-a during this wave (legacy clients). Please route via shim variant router-shim-20260303b. I'll pin that variant for the canary.

ashley: console: release notes drafted -> link: https://go/release/fastpath-canary. UI flag will be off by default; we'll enable only for the canary traffic slice. If rollback needed, console flips to ui-stable.

sre-oncall: Rollback criteria proposal:
- error_rate > 1% sustained for 3m OR
- absolute increase in p50 for request path (API->runtime) > 200ms vs baseline for 5m OR
- deploybot alerts on >3% 5xxs in canary slice
If any trigger, hold traffic and page oncall. Recommend manual rollback (kevin) with deploybot command: `deploybot rollback --job <canary-id>`

jon: Who will hit the physical rollback button? happy with kevin as owner but we should have an alternate (liya) in case of overlap. Also add a quick postmortem checklist if rollback happens.

kevin: I will be primary. liya alt. I will watch runtime metrics (batching latency, KV hit-rate) and coordinate with @sre-oncall.

marta: Locking pins now: runtime.kernel=kernel-quantize@v1.14, router.variant=router-shim-20260303b, console.flag=off.

marta: Final checks: console release_notes ok? ashley: yes. routing pin ok? liya: pinned. runtime pin ok? kevin: pinned and noted in the canary job.

marta: Proceeding to start the canary at 00:32 UTC. If anyone needs to abort, shout here or DM kevin. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started at 1738460000 (job id=cb-1738460000). Monitoring hooks attached: latency, error_rate, kv_hit_rate.
